data.text: Live A/B 2026-09-28: 20 questions (from the blind paraphrase set, stratified 4 decision / 5 note / 4 task / 7 doc), 40 Sonnet agents, one forced to start with search, one forbidden it. Correct: 19/20 with search, 17/20 without. Context added over a bare agent (82.6k fixed): median 6.0k vs 11.9k tokens, sum 121k vs 247k; tool calls median 2 vs 5 (max 5 vs 16); wall time median 15 s vs 31 s. Search was cheaper on 19 of 20 and faster on 18. The live hit rate is well above single-shot retrieval (51/100 in top 3) because the agent rephrases and searches again. One no-search agent answered from docs/decisions on the owner's disk, which a fresh clone does not have (DEC-20).
